sentences.text: Dwyane Tyrone Wade Jr. -LRB- -LSB- dweɪn -RSB- ; born January 17 , 1982 -RRB- is an American professional basketball player for the Chicago Bulls of the National Basketball Association -LRB- NBA -RRB- .	NBA	National Basketball Association	Chicago Bulls	Chicago Bulls	basketball	basketball	National Basketball Association	National Basketball Association
He has established himself as one of the most well-known and popular players in the league .

Wade had the top-selling jersey in the NBA for nearly two years , leading the league in jersey sales from the 2005 NBA Playoffs , until the midpoint of the 2006 -- 07 season .	NBA	National Basketball Association	2006	2006 NBA Finals	2005 NBA Playoffs	2005 NBA Playoffs

After a successful college career at Marquette , Wade was drafted fifth overall in the 2003 NBA draft by the Miami Heat .	NBA	National Basketball Association	Marquette	Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball	Miami Heat	Miami Heat	2003	2003 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans	2003 NBA draft	2003 NBA draft
He was named to the All-Rookie team and the All-Star team the following twelve seasons .	All-Rookie	NBA All-Rookie Team

In his third season , Wade led the Heat to their first NBA championship in franchise history and was named the 2006 NBA Finals MVP .	NBA	National Basketball Association	2006	2006 NBA Finals	NBA Finals MVP	Bill Russell NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award	2006 NBA Finals MVP	NBA Finals MVP

At the 2008 Summer Olympics , Wade led the United States men 's basketball team , commonly known as the `` Redeem Team '' , in scoring , and helped them capture gold medal honors in Beijing , China .	basketball	basketball	2008 Summer Olympics	2008 Summer Olympics	Redeem Team	The Redeem Team

In the 2008 -- 09 season , Wade led the league in scoring and earned his first NBA scoring title .	NBA	National Basketball Association	NBA scoring title	List of National Basketball Association annual scoring leaders

With LeBron James and Chris Bosh , Wade guided Miami to four consecutive NBA Finals from 2011 to 2014 , winning back-to-back championships in 2012 and 2013 .	NBA	National Basketball Association	2012	2012 NBA Finals	2013	2013 NBA Finals	LeBron James	LeBron James	Chris Bosh	Chris Bosh
